P3C-A-EVAL-NU-TRIANGULAR_MILESTONES-01:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER running=0.
NUMBER answer=1.
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<=n, i++) { running+=i. IF (i%3==0) { answer+=running. } }
DISPLAYNL(answer).
P3C-A-EVAL-NU-ALTERNATING_ACCUMULATOR-01:
NUMBER n.
INPUT(n).
NUMBER total=1.
LOOP (NUMBER i=1 TILL i<=n, i++) { IF (i%2==0) { total-=i. } ELSE { total+=i. } }
DISPLAYNL(total).
P3C-A-EVAL-AR-NEGATIVE_POSITION_WEIGHT-0:
IMPORT strings.
SENTENCE line.
INPUT(line).
SENTENCE[] parts = strings.SPLIT(line, "|").
NUMBER a = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[0]).
NUMBER b = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[1]).
NUMBER c = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[2]).
NUMBER d = strings.TO_NUMBER(parts[3]).
NUMBER[] values=[a,b,c,d].
NUMBER total=1.
LOOP (NUMBER i=0 TILL i<4, i++) { IF (values[i]<0) { total+=(0-values[i])*(i+1). } }
DISPLAYNL(total).
